title: ARTAI: An Evaluation Platform to Assess Societal Risk of Recommender Algorithms
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure anything related to faith or religion. It describes a platform for assessing general societal risk from recommender algorithms.
findings: The paper presents a system for evaluation and does not contain findings. There is no mention of religion.
